solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2.**** **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**thrived**" means to grow or develop well or vigorously. (फलाफूला)
 
• In this context, **"thrived"** accurately describes the long-lasting and prosperous existence of the silk routes until the fifteenth century.
 
• The other options: "**languished**," "**retreated**," and "**radiated**" do not fit the context of the sentence as effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *They are known to have existed since before the Christian Era and thrived__ almost till the fifteenth century.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Languished (विपन्नता)**: means to suffer from being forced to remain in an unpleasant situation.
 
• **Retreated (पीछे हटना)**: means to withdraw from a position.
 
• **Radiated (प्रसारित)**: means to emit energy or waves.
